Official source located and fetched at pa.gov/content/dam/copapwp-pagov/en/penndot/documents/public/dvspubsforms/bdl/bdl-manuals/motorcycle-operators-manual/english/pub%20147.pdf. EXAM MECHANICS PARTIALLY HEDGED: PA's motorcycle knowledge test is NOT broadly waived -- confirmed via pa.gov/services/dmv/get-a-class-m-motorcycle-license and the PAMSP FAQ (pa.gov/agencies/dmv/faqs/driver-licensing-faqs/motorcycle-permit-faqs) that completing a PAMSP Basic Rider Course (or the 3-Wheel Basic Rider Course) waives only the on-cycle SKILLS test at a PennDOT Driver License Center; the written knowledge test remains required for all standard-path applicants, and must be passed again on every permit reapplication per the manual (p.39). However, neither PennDOT's official pages nor the manual itself publish an exact item count or passing percentage for the knowledge test anywhere checked this session -- third-party test-prep sites (driving-tests.org, zutobi.com, dmv-permit-test.com and others) consistently report a 20-question test with 16 correct (80%) required to pass, matching the format independently used for the CA/GA/MI/OH/VA/WA/TX/NY motorcycle tracks in this project, but this specific number is NOT officially confirmed by PennDOT for the motorcycle knowledge test and MUST be flagged as an unconfirmed stand-in in the EXAM_CONFIGS code comment at wiring time, same convention as other hedged tracks (e.g. tx_motorcycle, mn_driver).
